text: Nora wanted to fly a kite, but the kite was torn. Nora said, “I would like to repair the kite.” Dad told Nora, “The boat needs a sail.” Nora said, “I want to make a sail.” Dad cut a small sail from the kite with the scissors. Nora tied the sail to the boat with the string. She set the boat on the pond. Nora and Dad watched the boat. The boat sailed across the pond.
